prompt.es: Escribe tu artículo de opinión sobre las pantallas de noche.

answer.text: Screens at night are a serious problem for teenagers. One cause is that many of them use screens until bedtime. Another cause stems from notifications that keep arriving at night. As a result, they sleep less, and this can lead to poor focus in class. Consequently, their marks may fall and they may feel tired every day. If this habit continues, it is likely that more teenagers will get too little rest. Unless families set clear rules, the problem will probably grow. In my opinion, schools and families must talk about this habit now.

If this habit continues, it is likely that more teenagers will get too little rest. Unless families set clear rules, the problem will probably grow. In my opinion, schools and families must talk about this habit now.

Using screens at night is a problem for many teenagers. One cause is that they use their phones until bedtime. Another cause is due to notifications that arrive late at night. As a result, they sleep less, which can lead to poor focus at school. Consequently, their marks may get worse and they may feel tired all day. It is likely that more teenagers will feel tired if nothing changes. Unless families make clear rules, the problem will probably get bigger. I think everyone should talk about this habit now.

prompt.es: Resume el acuerdo familiar con tres normas y una condición.

answer.text: At our family meeting, we agreed on three rules. First, I suggest we keep phones in the kitchen at night, because late screens lead to poor sleep. Second, I would allow games at the weekend on one condition: homework comes first. Third, we will limit video time to one hour a day on school days. Mum said that sounds fair, as long as I can use my phone until nine. To sum up, we have a deal, and if we follow this agreement, we will probably argue less and sleep better.
accepted: At our family meeting, we agreed on three rules. First, I suggest we keep phones in the kitchen at night, because late screens lead to poor sleep. Second, I would allow games at the weekend on one condition: homework comes first. Third, we will limit video time to one hour a day on school days. Mum said that sounds fair, as long as I can use my phone until nine. To sum up, we have a deal, and if we follow this agreement, we will probably argue less and sleep better.

We had a family meeting and we agreed on three rules. First, we will keep all phones in the kitchen at night, because late screens result in poor sleep. Second, games are allowed at the weekend on one condition: the homework must be finished first. Third, video time is limited to one hour a day on school days. My mum thinks this is fair, as long as I can use my phone until nine. To sum up, we have an agreement, and if we follow it, we will probably argue less.

feedback.es: Un buen resumen propone, justifica, fija una condición, limita el uso y cierra con una predicción prudente.
